rate_limits: Typically 900 requests per minute for most REST endpoints; some write endpoints lower. Exact limits may vary by account/plan.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: ORIGINAL CONFIRMED. Official PagerDuty rate-limiting docs state most REST endpoints are limited to ~900 requests/minute, with some write endpoints lower, and limits may vary by account/plan — matching the entry. Verifier B's note is cautionary (confirm on docs) not a factual correction of the published 900/min figure. Evidence: https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/ZG9jOjExMDI5NTU4-rate-limiting (and REST API overview rate-limiting docs).
